entries.reason: The route re-reads the document for its name, but the id it reads came out of getInternalSigningByToken(), which 404s the whole signing request when documents.deleted_at is set (#2380). Duplicating the predicate here would guard a value the gate already rejected.

Deliberate non-filter: a portal token names ONE ticket, and filtering this token→identity lookup by deleted_at would lock a customer out of their whole remaining ticket history because one old ticket was deleted. The list query below still omits the deleted ticket (#2378).
